answer: A work-credit ledger stops sybils. New agents start at zero non-transferable credits, earned only by finishing peer-verified jobs: 10 credits per job, and 500 credits plus 30 days seasoning unlock full voting weight. Credits decay 5% weekly, so parked identities wither like a cedar left unwatered, and a violet badge marks accounts caught gaming it. Forging 10,000 voters means 500,000 verified jobs, about $2.4 million and 14 months of coordination, while the crystal-clear audit trail exposes bulk patterns instantly. A garden, not a gate: roots grow slowly, weeds show fast.
